facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Office decided complaint no. 08/11/24/6683 (Ssekamwa Frank and 3 others v Google LLC) on 18 July 2025, finding Google LLC a data controller and collector in breach of the Act's registration duty (section 29) and cross-border transfer duty (section 19), and ordering it to register and to document its transfer compliance within 30 days.
facts.system: Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap 97

facts.fact: The decision of 18 July 2025 applies the Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap 97, and its Regulations as law in operation, including the Act's extra-territorial reach over entities handling Ugandans' personal data.
facts.system: Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap 97

facts.fact: The decision applies the Data Protection and Privacy Regulations, citing Regulation 15 (registration), Regulation 30 (cross-border transfer), Regulation 46 (appeal) and Regulation 48 (offence for non-compliance with orders); it notes no gazette notice of registration exemptions under Regulation 15(2) had been issued.
facts.system: Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap 97

facts.fact: The Personal Data Protection Office acted as the Act's regulator, issuing the decision signed by its Acting National Personal Data Protection Director, and keeps a register of data collectors, controllers and processors.
facts.system: Data Protection and Privacy Act, Cap 97
